description: This file defines the class SuiteCRM\StateCheckerDirectoryIterator, which extends RecursiveFilterIterator to provide a custom directory iterator that filters for readable directories. It is used within the SuiteCRM project to facilitate directory traversal.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\StateCheckerDirectoryIterator
classes.description: A custom directory iterator that filters for directories that are readable and directories only, used within SuiteCRM for directory traversal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a directory path, ensuring it is readable and a directory, then wraps it in a RecursiveDirectoryIterator with SKIP_DOTS option.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines whether the current directory entry is a readable directory, used to filter directory entries during iteration.
